description: The sum of the Moran numbers that are at most n. Through 1 it is 0, through 18 it is 18, through 21 it is 39, through 30 it is 66, and through 100 it is 300. n runs from 1 to 2000. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/moran-sum
